notes.title: Strategic Victory
notes.notes:
Age of Cards: Ra's Chess is a strategy-focused game where cards play a crucial role in determining the outcome. In this post, I'm sharing the secret to strategic victory: Changing the game's fate by harnessing the power of cards! Using a card at the right time and in the right way can alter your opponent's move and unlock the doors to victory. Join me in exploring the key to strategic victory in the world of Ra's Chess, and let's discuss new strategies on Discord.

http://discord.gg/ageofcards

notes.title: A Special Thanks to Our Community and Our Journey of Progress!
notes.notes:
Hello fellows, our "Steam Card Festival" has come to an end, and we have started evaluating the feedback received from the community and making necessary adjustments. First of all, we would like to thank you for the support you have provided us. Although we haven't reached the desired audience and couldn't increase our wishlist numbers significantly, we will continue to work on this issue and take further steps in advertising and promotion. Like you, we are also aware of the potential of our game "Age of Cards" and we will continue to develop it to the best of our ability with all our belief. Even though our community may be small, we will never forget the support you have given us and will continue to offer gifts to all community members who have been following us since the beginning. Don't forget to follow the announcements as we'll soon have even more exciting events. You can also join our Discord to keep up with the announcements.

http://discord.gg/ageofcards

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
*Bot Improvements:
Various improvements have been made to in-game bots. Bots are now smarter and more challenging.
   
*Tutorial Addition:
An interactive tutorial has been added for new players. Players can now better learn the fundamentals of the game.
   
*New Card Visuals:
Visuals for cards in the game have been updated. Cards are now more visually appealing and distinctive.
   
*Play Test and Demo:
Various updates have been made to the play test and demo versions of the game. These updates aim to make the gaming experience smoother and include bug fixes.
